assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other underlying cardiac arrhythmias
to correlate these symptomatic events with rhythm disturbances and guide further management
This is a medically necessary 48-hour Holter monitoring study to document and characterize the patient's intermittent cardiac arrhythmias and syncopal episodes
which cannot be captured by a routine ECG
